name: Redridge Mountains
summary: Redridge Mountains face attacks from Shadowhide gnolls and Blackrock orcs of the Dark Horde. Rushing rivers cut through wooded slopes around Lake Everstill, but Lakeshire must hold the line with help from wandering mercenaries while Stormwind’s forces are tied up by strife at home.

sections.title: A Bastion Under Siege
sections.body: Redridge was once among the kingdom’s most peaceful regions, supplying Stormwind with timber, freshwater fish, and crops. Now Lakeshire stays fortified against aggressive incursions. Stonewatch Keep, once a proud stronghold of the kingdom, has fallen to renegade Blackrock orcs. Their control cuts off roads and threatens to overrun the eastern valleys.

sections.title: The Divided Range
sections.body: These peaks form part of the spine running down the subcontinent of Azeroth. Centuries ago, the range stretched much farther north. Then the Dark Iron clan summoned the Firelord Ragnaros by accident, and the earth tore open to form the fiery crater of Blackrock Mountain. The cataclysm left the northern peaks severed into the ash choked Burning Steppes. Only the southern Redridge valleys remain lush and green, exposed to attacks from the slopes above.

sections.title: Neglected by the Crown
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris plead for reinforcements, but Stormwind’s regency council has left Lakeshire to fend for itself. Desperate entreaties to Sentinel Hill and Darkshire bring no help; both settlements are crippled by crises of their own. With no reinforcements in sight, local magistrates hire any capable sellsword willing to brave the Lakeridge Highway, clear the gnoll camps, and push back the danger over Lake Everstill.

sections.title: The Hidden Allegiances
sections.body: Morganth, a rogue warlock, first allied with the Blackrock orcs to seize Stonewatch Keep. He later betrayed them and bound the Shadowhide gnolls to his service from the Tower of Ilgalar. Reports recovered during the Blackrock investigation also reveal an alliance between the orcs and the black dragonflight.

faq.q: Why won't Stormwind send soldiers to help Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Lakeshire’s surviving royal soldiers are badly outnumbered after the loss of Stonewatch Keep. Magistrate Solomon has appealed for troops, weapons, food, and supplies, but Stormwind’s forces are stretched thin, and neighboring settlements face troubles of their own. The garrison relies on adventurers to help hold the region.

Blackrock orcs affiliated with the Dark Horde control Stonewatch Keep. From the mountain stronghold, they threaten the eastern valleys and travel along the Lakeridge Highway. Their ties to other local threats emerge during the investigation.

faq.q: What threats dwell in Lake Everstill?
faq.answer: Hostile murloc tribes infest Lake Everstill and raid nearby docks and ruins. Swimmers also face predatory threshadons beneath the surface, prompting rumors of aquatic monsters in the depths.

faq.q: Are there any Horde outposts in Redridge?
faq.answer: Redridge has no Horde settlements, vendors, or flight paths. Horde travelers passing through are generally en route between the Burning Steppes to the north and the Swamp of Sorrows to the southeast, navigating Alliance held roads and hostile wilderness.

The Three Corners is a crossroads in southwest Redridge. It joins the Lakeridge Highway to the eastern border of Elwynn Forest and the road into Duskwood, making it a vital transit point often targeted by wandering gnolls and wild beasts.

faq.q: Why is the northern path to the Burning Steppes so perilous?
faq.answer: The trail north past Render’s Camp climbs straight into the Burning Steppes, a desolate volcanic wasteland ruled by powerful Blackrock orcs, fire elementals, and dragonkin. That sudden rise in danger makes the northern mountain pass one of southern Azeroth’s deadliest climbs.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, you can hone your skills at Lakeshire, a frontline hub facing organized orcs and gnolls.
The Blackrock orcs entrenched in Redridge belong to the hostile Dark Horde, making them enemies of Thrall’s Horde as well as the humans in Lakeshire.
You can find copper, tin, and rare silver veins in the rocky crags and valleys around Lake Everstill, especially near the Rethban Caverns.
The temperate mountain slopes support Briarthorn, Bruiseweed, Mageroyal, and Swiftthistle.
